speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pregnant patient presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To better understand your condition, how many weeks pregnant are you, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Your history of consuming unpasteurized dairy (ice cream) shortly before symptom onset is concerning for *Listeria monocytogenes* infection, which can cause fever, headache, and flu-like symptoms in late pregnancy. Did you experience any gastrointestinal symptoms like diarrhea or nausea before the fever started, and have you noticed any contractions, leaking fluid, or decreased fetal movement?
